module Control.CaseReturn

function score(choice: Integer) returns Integer
    ensures (choice = 1 and result = 10) or (choice = 2 and result = 20) or (choice != 1 and choice != 2 and result = 0)
is
    case choice is
        when 1 =>
            return 10
        when 2 =>
            return 20
        default =>
            return 0
    end case
end score

procedure main()
is
    check score(2) = 20
end main

end Control.CaseReturn
